claims.text: Raytheon Company, through RTN Acquisition Corporation, offered $64.00 per share in cash for all E-Systems shares under an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated as of 2 April 1995; the offer expired on 28 April 1995 with approximately 96.46 per cent of shares tendered, and Raytheon's press release of 1 May 1995 announced completion of a transaction 'valued at $2.3 billion'.

edges.label: Raytheon acquired E-Systems outright, completed 1 May 1995
edges.note: Raytheon acquired E-Systems outright on 1 May 1995, taking its reconnaissance, surveillance and intelligence-collection business lines into the Raytheon node the board already carries.
